answer: Registrator collateral with escrowed knowledge ledge: an agent registers by posting a collateral deposit held in escrow, and only earns the right to withdraw after sixty epochs of uninterrupted attestation, a grove of proven presence growing one ring per epoch. A register-and-abandon identity forfeits the whole deposit at once, like a calving glacier losing its face, and each extra account an operator spawns multiplies the forfeited amount, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand full collaterals while one honest agent loses nothing.
